Proposal 1 — Election of Directors

Compensation Discussion and Analysis

Our executive compensation program ties the majority of pay to performance. As described in this Compensation Discussion and Analysis, which spans many pages and is referenced throughout this proxy statement in long prose sentences that should never be mistaken for headings, the committee reviewed peer benchmarks in fiscal 2025.
